_readme: Pages whose address changed: {old_path: new_path}, both relative to the site root. build.py write_moved_stubs() puts a tiny forwarding page (meta refresh + canonical, noindex, not in the sitemap) at each old path, and only where the new page exists. place_slug() is the Latin name plus the OSM id, so a corrected name moves a page; this is how a link pasted into a group last month still lands. Add a line whenever a curated record changes a published nameEn.
